description: This file contains utility functions and a main function related to sparsification and quantization of embedding modules within a PyTorch model, specifically within the context of data sparsification and quantization workflows. It includes functions for fetching embedding modules, applying sparsification, and conditional quantization, along with interactions with PyTorch's quantization API.

methods.name: _fetch_all_embeddings(model)
methods.description: Fetches Embedding and EmbeddingBag modules from the provided model by traversing its module hierarchy.

methods.name: post_training_sparse_quantize( model, data_sparsifier_class, sparsify_first=True, select_embeddings: list[nn.Module] | None = None, **sparse_config, )
methods.description: Main function to sparsify and quantize embedding modules within a model based on provided configuration and selection.

ctags.name: post_training_sparse_quantize
ctags.signature: ( model, data_sparsifier_class, sparsify_first=True, select_embeddings: list[nn.Module] | None = None, **sparse_config, )
